brief: 6 kitchen tools that replaced 30 — minimalist home cook edition.

slots.headline: CAN 6 TOOLS REPLACE 30?
slots.subtitle: the minimalist home cook's guide to a clutter-free kitchen

slots.title: ONE CHEF'S KNIFE
slots.body: A sharp 8-inch chef's knife handles slicing, dicing, and mincing. Ditch the paring, bread, and utility knives. One blade, zero clutter.

slots.title: CAST IRON SKILLET
slots.body: Sear, bake, roast, and fry in one pan. It replaces non-stick skillets, griddles, and baking dishes. Naturally non-stick with time.

slots.title: ONE DUTCH OVEN
slots.body: Braise, stew, bake bread, and slow-cook without extra gadgets. It takes the place of a slow cooker, stockpot, and roasting pan.

slots.title: HEAVY KITCHEN SHEARS
slots.body: Snip herbs, trim poultry, open packages, and cut pizza. They replace herb strippers, poultry shears, and box cutters with ease.

slots.title: IMMERSION BLENDER ONLY
slots.body: Blend soups directly in the pot, whip cream, and make smoothies. It replaces a countertop blender, food processor, and hand mixer.

slots.title: ONE MICROPLANE GRATER
slots.body: Zest citrus, grate cheese, mince garlic, and shave nutmeg. It replaces a zester, garlic press, ginger grater, and box grater.

slots.headline: DECLUTTER YOUR KITCHEN
slots.body: Pick one tool to donate this week. Less clutter, more calm.
